# fjordrun_deployments (Data Source)

A service's deployments in one environment, newest first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "service_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "environment_id" {
  type = string
}

data "fjordrun_deployments" "recent" {
  service_id     = var.service_id
  environment_id = var.environment_id
  limit          = 5
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_id` (String) Service ID.

### Optional

- `environment_id` (String) Environment ID. Defaults to the project's default environment.
- `limit` (Number) How many (1-200, default 30).

### Read-Only

- `deployments` (Attributes List) The deployments. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deployments))
- `id` (String) Identifier of this result.

<a id="nestedatt--deployments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deployments`

Read-Only:

- `commit_author` (String) Commit author.
- `commit_message` (String) Commit message.
- `commit_sha` (String) Commit.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `environment_id` (String) Environment ID.
- `finished_at` (String) End time.
- `id` (String) Deployment ID.
- `image` (String) Deployed image.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether it serves the service.
- `service_id` (String) Service ID.
- `started_at` (String) Start time.
- `status` (String) `queued`, `building`, `deploying`, `success`, `failed`, `crashed`, `cancelled`, `skipped` or `removed`.
- `trigger` (String) What started it.
